text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — I need to duck out at 17:50 UTC for a personal thing. Can we swap primary for the 18:00-22:00 UTC window? Current plan: Ajay primary, Tim secondary. If someone can cover primary for that window I’ll hand off the checklist now.

Sasha (oncall-bot): reminder: please follow the oncall handoff checklist: https://redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff (confirm active alerts, handoff notes, contact info). Automations: rotate-schedule required for formal swap.

Ajay Patel: I can take the 18:00-20:00 slice if that helps. I have a deploy at 20:15 though so I can’t cover 20:15-22:00. @Tim Nguyen — want to flip the last half?

Tim Nguyen: yep I can cover 20:00-22:00. I’ll be primary starting 20:00. Ajay — can you update the rotation on the calendar and mark the partial swap?

Maria Chen: thanks both. Quick runbook notes before I go: recent patient-search latency spike was yesterday but no open incidents now. If you get a page for high tail latency, first checks:

```# check redis rate and pending queues
kubectl -n prod get pods | grep search
kubectl -n prod logs svc/search-api -c inference --since=10m | tail -n 200
redis-cli -h redis-main info | grep used_memory_rss
```

Also check the batching-service metrics: https://metrics/redwood/batching?env=prod (look at queued_batches, avg_batch_ms). If you see queued_batches > 500 for > 2m, escalate to infra-sre.

Lena Ruiz: pinging infra-sre on rotation: @infra-sre — can you keep an eye on autoscaler configs between 19:30-21:00? We might need to bump min_replicas if traffic spikes.

inc-bot: incident-3654 CLOSED — patient-search increased 99pct CPU at 03:14 UTC, mitigated by autoscaler; root cause still under investigation.

Ajay Patel: updated calendar and left a handoff note in the runbook page with timestamps and contact numbers. I’ll be reachable on Slack and phone (ajay p). Leaving my dev session open until 19:50 in case something pops up.

Tim Nguyen: confirmed — I’ll be primary 20:00-22:00 UTC, Ajay secondary for 18:00-20:00 per swap. Maria — can you drop any open tickets you want me to watch in this thread?

Maria Chen: added two quick items to the runbook: ticket #INC-8429 (ongoing slow queries) and a small eval harness that flaps on long seq lengths. Also note my fallback plan: if both Ajay/Tim are busy, Sasha (oncall-bot) will trigger the regional fallback group at 20:30 and page infra-sre.

Sasha (oncall-bot): rotation updated: primary -> Ajay Patel (18:00-20:00 UTC), primary -> Tim Nguyen (20:00-22:00 UTC). Secondary -> Ajay Patel for 20:00-22:00 (shadow). Ran rota-check: no conflict with PTO.

Maria Chen: perfect. final quick checks before I leave: Ajay — verify you can run the `reindex` toggle if search backlog appears (runbook step 4). Tim — verify you can access the emergency SSH jump host (it’s `jump.prod.redwood`) and that your key is present.

Ajay Patel: verified reindex toggle access and added short note in runbook.

Tim Nguyen: SSH key confirmed. I have escalation phone numbers in my notes.

Lena Ruiz: added an observers tag for the weekend cohort. If anything degrades I’ll be on standby 19:00-21:00.

Maria Chen: thanks all — tagging the thread as the official handoff record. Leaving now, back by 22:30 UTC if anything urgent. :white_check_mark:

Sasha (oncall-bot): acknowledged. Handoff complete and logged by Maria Chen at 17:50 UTC.
